strings.welcome.doc:
# Welcome to MakDown

Markdown, but **fancier**. Edit on the left, watch it render on the right.

## Try these
- [x] Switch themes in *Settings* (Ctrl+,): GitHub, Windows 11, TTY, opencode, Warm ...
- [ ] Turn on **vimkeys** (Ctrl+Alt+V) and press `Esc`, then `dd`, `yy`, `p`, `u`
- [ ] Toggle paragraph marks (Ctrl+Shift+L) for Word-style ¶ marks
- [ ] Toggle *reveal markers* (Ctrl+Shift+M) to see the hidden `*`, `-`, `#` in the preview

> Tip: clone a preset in Settings, give it a name and make it your own.

### A table
| Key            | Action            |
|----------------|:-----------------:|
| Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I| bold / italic     |
| Ctrl+K         | insert link       |
| Alt+Up/Down    | move line (vim)   |

### Code
```cpp
int main() { return 0; }   // fenced blocks get their own styling
```

strings.settings.title: MakDown — Settings
strings.theme.label: Theme
strings.theme.readOnlyHint: Stock presets are read-only. Press Clone... to make an editable copy under your own name.
strings.theme.frameHint: MakDown draws its own title bar and a themed window border instead of the Windows ones. Resizing, snapping and the shadow stay native. Turn off to get the standard Windows frame (takes effect when you close Settings).
strings.theme.codeLabel: Show language label on code blocks
strings.dlg.nameTaken.title: Name taken
strings.dlg.deletePreset.title: Delete preset
strings.dlg.deletePreset.text: Delete "%1"? The .jsonc file will be removed.
strings.editor.vimHint: Modal editing (normal / insert / visual, d y c p u, counts, :w :q, /search) plus extras: Alt+Up/Down moves a line, Ctrl+Shift+D duplicates it, Ctrl+D / Ctrl+U scroll half a page.
strings.editor.marksHint: Word-style formatting marks: a pilcrow after every paragraph.
strings.editor.spacesHint: Dots for spaces, arrows for tabs.
strings.editor.sidebarHint: Files, Search and Git on the left (Ctrl+Shift+E).
strings.preview.revealHint: Shows the usually invisible *, -, #, > and ` characters as faint ghost glyphs in the preview.
strings.preview.liveHint: Re-render while typing. When off, press F5 or save to refresh.
strings.preview.syncHint: The preview follows the editor's scroll position.
strings.preview.liveReloadHint: Browser tabs reload when the page or its .html / .js / .css files change on disk.
strings.anim.0.name: Don't distract me
strings.anim.1.name: Keep it sober
strings.anim.1.hint: Quick fades and the explorer sliding in and out.
strings.anim.2.name: Make it pretty
strings.anim.2.hint: Fades, sliding panels, the window fading in and themes cross-fading when you switch.
strings.anim.3.name: Entertain me
strings.anim.3.hint: Everything above, slower and springier, smooth wheel scrolling, and a dancing equalizer in the audio preview.
strings.lang.title: Language
strings.lang.label: Interface language
strings.lang.restart: Restart MakDown to apply the new language.
strings.lang.hint: Languages are .json files in %1. Copy one, translate it and it shows up in this list after a restart.
strings.color.heading: Headings
strings.ai.title: AI Assistant
strings.ai.noKey: No API key for %1 yet. Add one in Settings > Preferences > AI.
strings.ai.includeDocTip: Attach the text of the file in the editor (and your selection) to each message
strings.ai.placeholder: Ask the assistant...  Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
strings.ai.empty: Ask me to write, edit or organise your Markdown. I can create files, read your project, run commands and ask you questions. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
strings.ai.stepLimit: Stopped after %1 steps in a row. Write "continue" to let it go on.
strings.ai.emptyReply: The model sent an empty reply.
strings.ai.confirm.title: The assistant asks for permission
strings.ai.confirm.create:
The assistant wants to create this file:

%1
strings.ai.confirm.write:
The assistant wants to overwrite this file:

%1
strings.ai.confirm.run:
The assistant wants to run this command in
%1

%2
strings.ai.ask.title: The assistant has a question
strings.ai.set.noAiHint: Turns every AI feature off: the AI tab, the AI menu and the assistant disappear, and MakDown never contacts an AI provider.
strings.ai.set.keyHint: Saved in ai.jsonc in MakDown's data folder (readable only by you). Left empty, the environment variable %1 is used if it is set. The base URL can stay empty to use the provider's default address; a custom provider needs an OpenAI compatible one, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1.
strings.ai.set.modelCustom: the model id your server expects
strings.ai.set.promptPlaceholder: For example: Answer in Polish. Use sentence case for headings. Keep notes short.
strings.ai.set.promptHint: Added on top of MakDown's own prompt in every conversation (your tone, language, writing style, project rules...). It cannot switch off the confirmation dialogs.
strings.ai.set.confirmFiles: Ask before the AI creates or overwrites files
strings.ai.set.confirmCmd: Ask before the AI runs terminal commands
strings.ai.set.confirmCmdHint: Recommended. A command runs with your permissions in the working folder.
strings.ai.sug3: Create a README for this folder
strings.ai.statusTip: Click to change provider, model or API key
strings.ai.set.showThinkingHint: Shows the reasoning some models return (collapsed, above the answer). It is only for you: it is never sent back to the model.
strings.ai.set.budgetHint: Anthropic only. Off, or at least 1024 tokens the model may spend thinking before it answers. More is slower and costs more. Other providers think on their own (reasoning models) or not at all.
strings.ai.set.streamHint: Shows the thinking and the answer while the model writes them. Turn it off for a server that cannot stream (MakDown also copes by itself when a server answers in one piece).
strings.ai.confirm.search:
The assistant wants to search the web for:

%1
strings.ai.confirm.fetch:
The assistant wants to download this web page:

%1
strings.ai.set.web: Let the AI search the web and read web pages
strings.ai.set.webHint: Adds the tools web_search and web_fetch. The search words and the addresses the model picks are sent to DuckDuckGo and to the sites it opens; the pages it reads go to your AI provider. Off: the model is told it has no web access.
strings.ai.set.confirmWeb: Ask before the AI searches the web or opens a page
